Name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
Ingredients: ["1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into cubes","1 red bell pepper, chopped","1 green bell pepper, chopped","1 onion, chopped","1 (15 ounce) can pineapple chunks, drained","1/2 cup soy sauce","1/4 cup brown sugar","2 tablespoons cornstarch","1 tablespoon rice vinegar","1 teaspoon ginger, ground","1/2 teaspoon garlic powder"]
Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine chicken, bell peppers, onion, and pineapple.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic powder.
3. Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables, and stir to coat.
4. Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) for 30-40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened.

Name: Classic Pancakes
Ingredients: ["1 cup all-purpose flour","1 teaspoon baking powder","1/2 teaspoon salt","1 tablespoon sugar","1 egg","1 cup milk","2 tablespoons vegetable oil"]
Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, milk, and vegetable oil.
3. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
4. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium heat.
5. Pour 1/4 cup of batter onto the griddle for each pancake.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown.

Name: Hearty Beef Stew
Ingredients: ["1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes","1 tablespoon olive oil","1 onion, chopped","2 carrots, peeled and chopped","2 celery stalks, chopped","4 cups beef broth","1 teaspoon thyme, dried","1/2 teaspoon rosemary, dried","1 bay leaf","1 lb potatoes, peeled and cubed","1 cup frozen peas"]
Instructions:
1. Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown beef in batches, then set aside.
2. Add onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in thyme and rosemary.
3. Return beef to the pot. Pour in beef broth and add bay leaf. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 1/2 - 2 hours, or until beef is tender.
4. Add potatoes and cook for 30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Stir in frozen peas during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
5. Remove bay leaf before serving.

Name: Spicy Chicken Curry
Instructions: 1. Marinate chicken. 2. Sauté onions, ginger, garlic. 3. Add tomatoes and spices. 4. Cook chicken in the sauce. 5. Simmer until done.

Name: Vegetarian Pasta Primavera
Instructions: 1. Cook pasta. 2. Steam vegetables. 3. Mix pasta and vegetables with cream sauce. 4. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. 5. Serve hot.
